[b][size=5]What does this mod include?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]A Unique NPC:[/b] Aurelian brings a cynical and high-tech perspective that contrasts with the quiet life of Pelican Town.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Seasonal Schedules:[/b] His schedule changes drastically with the seasons. During the warmer months, you’ll find him fulfilling certain family "responsibilities" outdoors, while in winter, he prefers to retreat into his technology.[/*]
[*][b]Immersive Dialogue:[/b] Over 100+ lines of dialogue that react to weather, other neighbors (especially Abigail, Sam, and Sebastian), and festivals.[/*]
[*][b]Full Integration:[/b] Custom dialogues for the Movie Theater, the Ginger Island Resort, and all calendar events.[/*]
[*][b]Logical Gift Tastes:[/b] Don't try to give him anything that might stain his clothes or his screen. His tastes reflect his urban life and technical interests.[/*]
[*][b]New Discovery:[/b] Learn a [b]unique cooking recipe[/b] through his events and discover his preference for a specific [b]tropical crop[/b] that reminds him of the exotic imports in Zuzu City.[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Character Profile[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Residence:[/b] Mayor’s Manor.[/*]
[*][b]Social Circle:[/b] Often seen near the arcade machines at the Saloon or trying to fit in with Sam and Sebastian’s group.[/*]
[*][b]Personality:[/b] Analytical, reserved, socially awkward, and deeply loyal to his gadgets.[/*]
[/list][center]-------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[b][size=5]Installation:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/*]
[*][b]If you play in English:[/b] Download the Main File and place it in your Mods folder.[/*]
[*][b]If you play in Spanish:[/b] Download only the Optional File and place it in your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Find Aurelian around town and break the ice![/*]
